Haaaah...!

Since then, no Umamusume appeared who was said to have surpassed her...
The world's thirst for the next legend only continued to swell.

If I could run the Twinkle Series with her, we'd see sights like no other.
That conviction swelled up inside me.
Shot down.
...I see, thanks. But sorry.
So, I'll just take the thought. Thanks, though!
Hey! You there, you!

I might have rushed it a bit... but timing is everything.
I poured out all the words I had to convey the awe I had just felt.
Turned down without hesitation, I was shot down for the second time.
Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

This is just a guess... but since she's turning down everyone,
looking at it another way, it doesn't mean she rejected you specifically.

15 wins out of 19 races, the second Classic Triple Crown Umamusume in history.
She left behind immense fervor on the turf, but——
Huh? Oh, you were a Trainer.
——Once, there was an Umamusume spoken of as a living legend.
And so——

This one's... horseshoes? Whoa, custom-made!
Huh, they reduce strain on the toes. How thoughtful.

If I take it, it'll get your hopes up, right?
I'm not good with that stuff. Sorry.
Well, anyway... sorry, but I can't take it.

After speaking this far, I realized I hadn't said anything concrete.
Racking my brain to come up with an example——
Seeing her in person, she's talented, not to mention her running style defies all common sense. That's why people think she might become the next Triple Crown Umamusume——

Shaking the earth, brushing away the rain, she dashed like the wind.
She was so vivid, it made me forget to breathe——

Her mother was a famous Umamusume, and her father was her Trainer!
Being their daughter, rumors have been swirling since before she enrolled.
Still, who'd come out to the track on a day like this——Hm?

She flew across the turf with extraordinary speed.
Her pace never slacked; if anything, she kept accelerating——

How captivated I was by her speed, stopping in my tracks to watch,
and how I felt certain we could see sights like no other together.

No, they think she might even surpass that living legend!
With such high hopes, Trainers scouting her have been lining up nonstop.

My bad, my bad, couldn't see well in the rain. Mistook you for someone else.
See ya!
Hm?

It's definitely too early to give up. If you've been turned down once,
isn't now your chance to show your persistence...?

Rounding the corner, 200 meters to the finish line.
With a mighty stride, staying low to the ground——she burst forward like a coiled spring.

Her breathtaking speed
accelerated again, and again, and again. Leaving common sense behind.
Huh? A present? Wow, thanks!
...The sheer shock made my heart race, and my legs trembled so much that I couldn't walk away.

...Still, it seems she's turned down every single offer so far with a hundred percent rejection rate. Status and past achievements mean nothing to her. Nobody even knows what kind of Trainer she's looking for.

Let's see... Huh, is this... a training menu?
I see! You put together a specialized menu just for me!
It seemed she was far more popular than I had imagined. Just as I lowered my head, thinking I was out of my league... my colleague lowered their voice meaningfully.

...*pant*, *pant*... Whew!
Ah! Running without an opponent really just isn't enough.
I spoke with her instructor, poured over her mock race results, and presented her with a carefully prepared gift. But—
That girl is Mr. C.B., isn't she?!

As if shattering that suffocating, stifling atmosphere—
there was an Umamusume running single-mindedly through the pouring rain.

Are you free right now?
Wanna run side-by-side with me—
